My parents’ lack of formal education made me self-teach it through curiosity, especially in physics and chemistry, but the structured approach isn’t intimidating for me; it’s rewarding.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Occasionally, if a problem feels too complex without prior exposure (e.g., calculus), my introverted nature might make me pause to organize thoughts. But I trust logic over fear—anxiousness usually fades once I break it down step-by-step.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No direct AI usage, but I’ve explored basic calculators or symbolic math tools (like Wolfram Alpha) for quick checks. AI isn’t a fear factor here; it’s more like a collaborative assistant for verifying steps rather than solving problems alone.
